content: Solho irotno ibandoc
Oro Filip yu youp ihoroc tongga idina amna au mano Sol yu Morömahon youp amnani doun moin toctocha toup kiringga youp morö togoc. Tongo yu öret socsoc böchon amna moröma yuot ongga inogoc,

“Sontho Yuda nanohon amna dugo Damaskas taun idangma yuha yongburoc bapiya au irim tongo namarut. Bapiyadec wömai mata ingoroc irim tarut: ‘Sol yu ogep ongga owihu o amnahu Yesuhon uyap sindarangma yu yabingga oburo fetmuna Yerusalem yangat fehangoc.’”

Ihoroc inuna amna morömaho bapiya worochon toroc irim tongga imuna Sol yu wohogon Damaskas onggonga uyap forosigoc. Tongo yu Damaskas ong fom tongidina momdecma yaguno auho karupgon ohongga inodec tun waringmun mögoc.
Waringmun muuna Sol yu gurocdec möngga idina duc mata auho ingoroc inogoc, “Sol Sol! Gocu yaha sinom noc ti moin toctocha taroc?”
Ihoroc inuna Solho yogoc, “Moröma, goc numa?” Ihoroc yuna duc mataho yogoc, “Nocu Yesu, gocu noc ti mointocgon tongöharoc.
Goc idongga Damaskas taun ongoi. Wocin wömai amna auho yongburoc ganuna gocho worochon toroc tiruc.”
Oro mata ihoroc öngkuuna amna au Solot kondong itonggungma yu soroc yogung. Yu wömai gino au kombigung mahong amna inoi magung.
Tuna Sol yu idongga ‘danna foriwa’ yongo togoc mahong tun matuna daroho kumbong dingga idoc. Woroc tuna nucniho oburo sogito yangada Damaskas tonggung.
Yangada tonguya Sol yu sep youp toctoc anfi ihoroc daro kumbong dinggagon idoc. Tongo nacno yamuc manongidoc.

Oro Damaskas taun wocin wömai Yesuhon youp amna au mano Ananaias yu idoc. Woce idina Morömaho itudec yudec öngkungo yongburoc mata ingoroc inogoc, “Ananaias!” Ihoroc inuna yuho yogoc, “Moröma noc itat.”
Yuna Morömaho inogoc, “Goc idongga uyap mano ‘nongnongo’ wocin ongmina Yudasho bucin öhi. Böc wocin wömai Tarsusma amna au mano Sol yu wocin dönac yongga itac.

Yu wömai duc itu tongga agoc, ‘Amna au mano Ananaias yu yuot engmuna oburo bigodec out tohuna orokuna daro forigoc,’ ihoroc agocmaha gocho yuot ongmina ihoroc toi.” Ihoroc yuna Ananaiasho mata ökenne ibanda yogoc,
“Moröma, owi amna koböcmaho amna worochon fatno wömuno yuya kombingitat. Yu wömai Yerusalem sae gakain kunkun owi amna toup sinom doun obukongidang.
Tongo yu öret socsoc amna morömahon madec epac. Worocha yu gakain owi amnayai fogida yi bucin fohong yucyucha epac.”

Ihoroc yuna Morömaho mata wo kombingga Ananaias inogoc, “Goc botirocha ongoi. Nocho amna wo ‘nochon youp toun’ yongo eragot. Yu wömai ongmuna nochon ma sogito bumbumyi nanohu o kingnohu o Israel nanohu yudec yong fandat inangoc.
Tongo nochon maha tongga yu focfoc mepmo moröma sinom yaun fetnahing.”

Ihoroc inuna Ananaias yu mata woroc sumboda ongga böc ganang öngga oburoho Solhon bigodec out tohongga inogoc, “Oröcna Sol, Moröma Yesu yu uyapdec öngkung gamogoc. Tongo yu ‘gocho dara wönggon forihi o Kunkun Yaruho gocdec foctoun’ yongo noc nanong muuna ngo gocot epatma.”
Ihoroc inuna wohogon yapmu sugic simbang worocho Solhon darodec öcang muuna daro wönggon forigoc. Foringga idongga onguna Yesuhon madec yamuc gung imogung.
Yamuc gung imuya mit yu wönggon nacno nongga koing sogoc. Solho fatmata ogepma Damaskas taun wocin yogoc Sol yu koing songga sep youp toctoc au Damaskas kombing tobic tobic suraro ot wocin idoc.
Tongo yu forosingga Yuda nanohon fatmata yocyoc böc wocewoce öngmuna Yesuhon fatmata inong tongidoc. Yu wömai mata ingoroc fandat inongidoc, “Yesu yu woi Kopotorochon Manano.”

Ihoroc yuna owi amnaho Solhon mata woroc kombingga yuha irot yai tongga yogung, “Amna ngo yu Yerusalem itmuna owi amna Yesuhon ma kombing tobing imogungma yu doun moin tongidung. O önga yu öret socsoc amna dugohon madec ngocin engmuna ‘kombing tobic tobic owi amna fogito yibucin fohong yuangot’ yongo eboc yo. Oro amna inoi ngorochu nuhun?”

Owi amna Solha mata metec ihoroc yong tonggung mahong Sol yu koing songga Yuda nano Damaskas taun idungma yu tuctugo sinom ingoroc indagoc: Yesu yu woi Duic, amna Kopotorocho inong muuna ebocma woroc. Ihoroc indauna Yuda amnaho matano kombingga mata metec yocyocha wönggon makombigung.
Oro sep youp toctoc koböcma bödengina Yuda nanohon amna dugo yu engsuran tongga ‘Sol wotnaya ompun’ yongo mata yong torop sigung.
Ihoroc yuya Sol yu mata woroc kombingga korungon onggonga kombigoc mahong Yuda amnaho ‘yu sogit akep tona’ yongo taunthon simbu danong kumbong apmano gön tongga idung.
Gön tongga idiya amna Solhon mata toup kombingidungma yu kumbonggon Sol yangato taunthon gombo koroc tögung. Tuna yu dumbu moröma audec omoc idina siuya yidec gombo sumonne unimgon tomu mögoc.
Sol yu Yerusalem idoc
Tuna Sol yu Yerusalem öngmuna ‘Yesuhon surarodec sakaa fihun’ yongo kombigoc mahong suraroho yuha botogung. Yu wömai kombigung, yu ayam noni, yu Yesuhon amna muno. Ihoroc kombingga botogung.

Wohong Barnabas yu Sol tongfat yengo yangato aposelot tongo Solhon fatno moröma inongga yogoc, Solho uyapdec Moröma aun feuna Morömaho mata inogoc. Tuna Sol yu Damaskas ongmuna wocin Yesuhon madec fatmata ogepma orongi sinom owi amnadec yong fandat inogoc. Barnabas yu Solhon fatno ihoroc yogoc.
Worocha tongga suraroho Sol angbanauya yu yuot kondonggon ididoc. Tongo Sol yu Yerusalem sae ihorocgon Morömahon madec fatmata ogepma orongi sinom inong tongidoc.
Tongo yuho Yuda nano Grik mata yongidungma yuot matahogon emoc tongidoc mahong torop worocho yu wot omom toctocha kombigung.
Tuya kombing tobic tobic suraroho woroc kombingga Sol yangato Sisaria tonggung. Tongga inong muuya Tarsus onggoc.

Oro kombing tobic tobic suraro Yudia gurocinthu o Galili gurocinthu o Samaria gurocinthu yu mepmono muno ogepgon ididung. Tuna Kunkun Yaruho yu tongkoing tong imuna suraro ambaracho Moröma gending imongmuya yuhon mata sumbot tongidung. Tuya owi amna koböcmaho irotno ibaruya surarodec sakau figoc.
Pitaho amna au mano Ainias tun orokogoc
Oro Pita yu sa wocewoce itongidoc. Tongo yu ‘kombing tobic tobic suraro Lida taundec idangma yu yawa’ yongo sa woce onggoc.
Woce ongga itmuna yu amna au mano Ainias aun fedoc. Yu wömai kudatno ambarac sinom omong fatdup tongo biruc 8 ihoroc abamdecgon dungo ididoc.
Ihoroc idina Pitaho angga inogoc, “Ainias, Yesu Duicho goc tun orokotaroc. Goc idongga abam yoroca tobihi.” Ihoroc inuna yu wohogon idonggoc.
Idongga itonguna owi amna ambarac Lida orin Saron böcsa wocin idungmaho yu angmuya irotno ibanto Moröma kombing tobing imogung.
Pitaho Tabita tun wekogoc

Oro Yöpa böcsa wocin wömai Yesuhon youp owi au mano Tabita yu wocin ididoc. Grik matadec wömai mano au Dokas ihoroc yongidung. Yu wömai owi amna urocima tongfat yengo toroc kiap ogepmagon tong imongidoc.
Oro bongono worocho yu obukoc tongga omong fadoc. Tuna owi amnaho ep fambangno yamuc gung imocimocha tongo böc ganang töng siuya woce idoc.

Oro Lida taun wömai Yöpa böc tan ambehecgon idoc. Tuna kombing tobic tobic suraroho kombigungmai Pita yu Lida taun woce itac. Ihoroc kombingga yu amna yai inong muuya yu Pitaot ongmunya kiring imongo inogomoroc, “Goc inga ningo notot ehiya ongona.”

Ihoroc inunya Pitaho yuot onguna Yöpa ongkuuya yangga böc irotnon owi omongga idocan woce Pita yangat tögung. Tuya Pita yu woce idina owi kapi urociho yu angarenggumbec tongmuya yong ointongo Dokasho abe wec idocan manomano tec tohomumöcno tobing imogocma woroc indagung.

Ihoroc tuya Pitaho owi amna ambarac dong yaruna taitdec ohuya yu goruc yemoc tongo dönac yogoc. Tongo yu owi worochon ep fambangnodec foringga yogoc, “Tabita, goc idongoi.” Ihoroc inuna wohogon owi worocho wekongga daro foringga Pita angmuna idongga idoc.
Tuna Pitaho oburodec sogito tuun fadauna idonggoc. Tuna Pitaho owi kapi orin kombing tobic tobic suraro ambarac inong yuna ehuya yu owi Dokas woroc indagoc.
Oro Yöpa nano ambarac yu worochon fatno kombingmuya owi amna koböcmaho Moröma kombing tobing imogung.
Tuya Pita yu sa ubarago Yöpa wocin amna au mano Saimon yuot idoc. Saimon yu bot bulmakau godibo tobic tobic amna idoc.
